purpose: Admit already-created, Release-Trust-validated CEI evidence pull requests through ordinary exact-head protected MATHSOLVE merge after repository rules are satisfied, without branch-protection bypass, campaign mutation, or mathematical adjudication.
authority_source: existing GCL Release Trust GitHub App installation; short-lived per-run token only
required_preconditions: the branch is a registered CEI intake branch recognized by the upstream bounded controller
the branch revalidates against its protected dispatch and exact raw-plus-receipt evidence shape
an open ordinary pull request exists from that exact branch to main
the pull request author is gcl-release-trust[bot]
the pull request title exactly matches the registered profile and dispatch
the pull request head SHA equals the live intake branch SHA
the pull request is not draft and is not known unmergeable
repository protection requirements, including the unattributed-change documentary approval and required status checks, remain authoritative
the evidence-admission credential is a distinct short-lived token from the upstream intake token
allowed_actions: read registered intake branches and their protected dispatch bindings
read the existing ordinary evidence pull request
revalidate the exact raw-plus-receipt evidence branch using the upstream controller validation logic
request one ordinary protected squash merge with the validated pull-request head SHA supplied as the expected sha
retry on later wakes when GitHub repository protection has not yet admitted the merge
prohibited_actions: write repository contents or alter evidence branches
claim certification or canonical mathematical effect
use administration, actions-write, checks-write, issues-write, or workflow-write authority
use the contents-write admission token for any direct contents, refs, commits, trees, blobs, or branch API mutation
native_protection_rule: The controller may request an ordinary exact-head squash merge only after revalidation. GitHub required checks, required documentary approval, review-thread policy, and repository rules remain authoritative; no bypass actor exists.

wake.cadence: every 10 minutes plus the existing success-gated Administrative maintenance dispatcher wake and manual replay

live_acceptance_target.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 Resource not accessible by integration because merge endpoint requires contents:write
live_acceptance_target.required_result: controller merges exact head under repository protection, then protected raw and receipt blobs match the intake branch

upstream_intake.use: branch validation and ordinary evidence PR creation only

evidence_admission.use: exact-head protected merge request only; required because GitHub merge writes protected branch contents
